title: Resolve shared MSBuild project and document path properties
outcome: C# and F# admitted expressions share correct root-project and current-document path properties. Supported properties resolve from captured path context; known unprovided built-ins are not converted to assumed-empty guards.
acceptance: All applicable derived workspace-relative item/reference/Exists identity columns remain relative; intentional root metadata and original indexed source snapshots are excluded from the no-absolute scan. Existing relocation refusal/explicit-rebuild policy is unchanged. After explicit rebuild, path-independent fixtures remain equivalent and root-sensitive fixtures produce expected different results; pinned-reader and warm-cache behavior is verified. Add a root discriminator only if a failing regression demonstrates the existing identity is insufficient.

Current-document context follows nested imports and restores on return. Property RHS values capture ThisFile references at assignment in the defining document. Root-reserved and document-reserved classifications are separate, reserved assignments are protected, and ThisFile properties do not enter the global invariant-false proof.

Design and a singular shared capability entry describe the admitted behavior; version/schema changes cover the complete unshipped batch and numeric budgets remain unchanged. Format, Release build with zero warnings/errors, complete suite, fresh pinned Roslyn/F# MCP integration and website gates pass. Full uncommitted union receives completed dual review; Critical/High findings are fixed and verified by their original reviewers.

Focused RED/GREEN tests cover both complete families, actual language callers, nested imports and eager capture, spaces/root-level files/host separators/NoRoot, supported and unavailable built-ins, optional/incomplete controls, reserved assignment and invariant-proof boundaries, contained/outside paths, anchored/published roots, and cold/delta Exists capture and retraction.

One shared Core resolver is used by real admitted C# and F# callers for MSBuildProjectDirectory, MSBuildProjectDirectoryNoRoot, MSBuildProjectFullPath, MSBuildProjectFile, MSBuildProjectName, MSBuildProjectExtension, MSBuildThisFileDirectory, MSBuildThisFileDirectoryNoRoot, MSBuildThisFileFullPath, MSBuildThisFile, MSBuildThisFileName and MSBuildThisFileExtension. Values, filenames, host-root removal and trailing separators are correct without expanding existing C# import/condition admission.

Published logical workspace root is consistent across cold build, delta and pinned query evaluation and separate from anchored I/O paths. Contained absolute paths normalize to workspace-relative Import, Compile, ProjectReference, HintPath and Exists identities with each consumer's existing relative base; outside-workspace refusal and authority remain intact.

With valid captured path authority, PropertyGroup guards on MSBuildThisFileDirectory and MSBuildProjectDirectory != empty evaluate true, execute a decisive compiler-affecting assignment such as TOOLING, and emit no assumed-empty reason. Missing required path authority and known unprovided toolchain-dependent properties remain unresolved, not guessed from CWD, environment or Phoenix runtime. Optional user-property guards still distinguish absent, assigned and incomplete values with disclosure.

completion.summary: Shared 12-property MSBuild root/document context delivered for real C#/F# callers, with Private/optional-guard integration, Unix scalar/path provenance and transactional worktree-root Exists publication. Full gates and original Codex/Claude verification CLEAN; five nonblocking followups remain explicitly tracked. No commit/push.
